episodes.title: Peter Young on Cults, Freedom, and the Journey to Healing and Forgiveness
episodes.description:
In this episode of Wisdom on the Front Porch, LS Kirkpatrick chats with Peter Young about his journey as an author and his Thomas Connor series. They discuss his book "Stop the Tall Man, Save the Tiger," focusing on themes of cults, control, and personal liberty. Peter shares insights on family dynamics, parental alienation, and healing. The conversation covers the tools of control used by cult leaders, the importance of living in the present, and the power of journaling and forgiveness. They also discuss breaking free from cults and the significance of voluntary cooperation. The episode wraps up with Peter's upcoming projects and where to find his books.
